summary_1line: Rama proves his power by piercing seven Sala trees; Sugriva challenges Bali but is defeated when Rama cannot distinguish the brothers during their fight.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama releases a golden arrow that streaks through seven Sala trees, a mountain, and the earth before returning to his quiver.
Bali and Sugriva, nearly identical, clash with thunderous palm strikes and diamond-hard fists while Rama watches with drawn bow.
Bloodied and exhausted, Sugriva flees toward the forested Rishyamuka Mountain as Bali halts at the edge, restrained by a curse.
